images.name: curie
images.prompt: Edit this project-card icon, retaining its exact cream background, flat charcoal outlines, muted ochre fills, stroke weight and simple icon style. Correct the balance-scale geometry. A straight level horizontal beam rests on a central vertical post with a plain trapezoid base. Each end of the beam has ONE visible pivot. From each pivot, TWO thin diagonal suspension lines descend outward to the left and right rims of its shallow bowl, forming a symmetric triangle. Both bowls same size and height, evenly spaced from post. No suspension lines pass through objects. In the left bowl, a SMALL HORIZONTAL capsule sits entirely within the triangle, just above bowl base. In the right bowl, a SMALL square checkmark tile sits entirely within triangle, just above bowl base. Leave clear cream space between objects and suspension lines. Physically coherent, rigorously symmetrical, tidy crisp icon. Reduce objects if needed. No hanging vertical lines behind capsule or tile. No shading, realism, texture additions, text or ornamental details. Keep generous margins so entire scale fits a shallow banner.
